displayName: OCI-MITRE-ATTACK-030: MITRE T1037: Boot or Logon Initialization Scripts
description:
Detects ATT&CK technique T1037 (Boot or Logon Initialization Scripts). Adversaries may use scripts automatically executed at boot or logon initialization to establish persistence.(Citation: Mandiant APT29 Eye Spy Email Nov 22)(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019) Initiali

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_mitre_attack_mitre_attack_030", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%mitre%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%t1037%') AND "value" > 0
